description: Measurement event taxonomy (AD-12). Every event is one JSON object per line in the per-user-per-machine ledger ~/.tk-studio/measurements/<user>-<machine>.jsonl. Exactly one emitter class per event type: a skill emits its own surface events; the job wrapper alone emits job-level events — never both for one failure. Extending this taxonomy rides the PR membrane.

project.note: project key from the registry; omitted for machine-scoped events

payload.note: shape fixed per event type below

install-outcome.emitter: installer (tk-studio-install; tk-studio-base-update when it reruns the installer)

planes.note: per-plane results: bmad-base, plugin, store, vault, tracking (0.1.26, Story 31.4)

job-run.emitter: job wrapper alone (tk-studio-job — lib/jobrun.py), one event per terminal run transition; the target skill emits its own surface events — never both for one failure (AD-12)

reason.note: the guard, stop condition, or gap that ended a partial|blocked|cancelled run

total_cost_usd.note: the run's cost in USD, supplied to jobrun.py finish (--total-cost-usd); source: the worker's --output-format json result (total_cost_usd). Finite and non-negative; absent when the driver sent none, never zero-filled

playable_verify_cost_usd.note: Story 34.3: the playable-verify judge's total_cost_usd; counted in total_cost_usd when the engine's cost is metered — when the engine's cost is unmetered total_cost_usd is absent (never zero-filled) while this field is still sent

observation.emitter: evolve loop (research job types; tk-studio surfaces logging observed toil)

kind.note: Story 32.5: "meter" on the trial meter's per-story record (lib/meter.py); a record without it is history the quote does not read

epic.note: Story 32.5: the story key's leading integer

usd.note: Story 32.5: the story's usd_total at the prices_date list price

legs.note: Story 32.5: <leg>: {usd, usage: {input, output, cache_read, cache_write}} -- `usage`, never `tokens` (the ledger sanitizer redacts any key matching token); cache_write = cache_write_5m + cache_write_1h

prices_date.note: Story 32.5: the date of the prices.json the story was priced at

knowledge-promotion.emitter: promotion skill alone (tk-studio-knowledge — lib/promote.py emit; D4, ST-9.6): one event per batch of newly-merged drafts per (branch, base) — at the skill's run-on-every-invocation cadence, one event per merged promotion PR; two PRs merged between emits collapse into one event, never into two for the same draft. Reconciled against the per-project promotions record (knowledge.schema.json record_line): a draft file already covered by an emitted marker never re-emits — exactly-once per draft, never a duplicate, never a loss. Drafting emits nothing (a draft is a mover, AD-12); only the merge-detected emission lands here.

files.note: project-relative kb/ files the merged promotion PR landed

corrections.note: distinct correction identities (delta_key) across the emitted drafts

base.note: the branch the PR merged into

asset-generation.emitter: lib/assets.py generate alone (Story 34.7, the asset ladder's generated rung): one event per generator call, failed ones included, written through ledger.emit (AD-12); the generator's key never lands here

run_id.note: the run the call is charged to (generate --run-id)

task_id.note: the provider's task id, when the submit returned one

credits.note: the provider's reported charge when the response carries one, else the per-task estimate (MESHY_CREDITS_PER_TASK) with estimated: true

estimated.note: true when credits is the per-task estimate

stage.emitter: lib/measurepush.py push alone (Story 35.8): before the push, one event per completed `## Stage Log` row whose row_key the ledger does not hold yet, written through ledger.emit (AD-12); the harvest covers the --directory studio repo plus every registry root (DW-96; a missing or unreadable root, or an unreadable registry, is skipped and reported, never fatal; a registered studio checkout keeps bare sha12 row_keys, other registry roots are `<project_id>:<sha12>`); elapsed is never carried, only derived from started/ended

project.note: the project id the row's document belongs to (a registry root's registry id)

story.note: the story key (or the plan entity id, for the epic's planning row)

stage.note: plan, dev, review, consult, gate, host-leg, re-run, close-out, merge, …

pass.note: the stage's occurrence number, when it has one

started.note: ISO-8601 UTC, the clock of whoever ran the stage

usage.note: {input, output}: the row's tokens_in / tokens_out (the key is usage, never a token-named key: ledger.sanitize redacts those)

row_key.note: sha1(story|stage|pass|started)[:12], the dedupe key: the bare sha12 for the studio repo (the --directory and any registered studio checkout), `<project_id>:<sha12>` for other registry roots (DW-96)

source.note: the project-relative document the row was read from

sweep-triage.emitter: lib/launch.py sweep alone (Story 35.7, AD-12): once per triage read, when the engine's .bmad-loop/runs/<run_id>/triage.json is read by the launch verb, written through ledger.emit; the supervisor's queue note of the same name is a different store, and bmad-loop's own journal sweep-triage key is never recorded here

run_id.note: the engine run id (the sweep's pre-minted --run-id)

bundles.note: how many bundles the triage partitioned

dw_ids.note: every DW id the bundles carry, in bundle order

decisions.note: the DW ids awaiting a human decision (skipped unattended under --no-prompt)

already_resolved.note: the DW ids the triage found already resolved

skip.note: the DW ids the triage skipped
